facts.value: To convey communicative and intercultural foreign language skills.
Completion of level A2/B1 of the GER or 30 - 50 points in the placement test.

In the course 'Business French 1 - Foundation', you will learn vocabulary and expressions specifically for the business world. You will gain extensive knowledge of the French language and insights into the country, its society, and topics related to business life such as entrepreneurship, marketing strategies, and economic trends.
The number of participants is limited to a maximum of 20.
Unit 1 - Consumer Behavior, Unit 2 - Corporate Structure, Unit 3 - Financing a Project.
Oral participation and presentation, written exam in the last week of lectures. A graded certificate will be issued for successfully passing the exams.
90 Euros for WFR1 Foundation (13 double hours, including final exam).
Completion of level B1 of the GER or 50 - 75 points in the placement test.

In the course 'Business French 2 - Consolidation', you will learn vocabulary and expressions specifically for the business world. You will gain extensive knowledge of the French language and insights into the country, its society, and topics related to business life such as entrepreneurship, marketing strategies, and economic trends.
Unit 1 - Income, Employment and Unemployment, Unit 2 - Recruitment and Selection, Unit 3 - Economic sectors, Unit 4 - International Trade.
90 Euros for WFR2 Consolidation (13 double hours, including final exam).
Completion of level B2.1 of the GER or at least 75 points in the placement test.

In the course 'Business French 3 - Advanced', you will learn vocabulary and expressions specifically for the business world. You will gain extensive knowledge of the French language and insights into the country, its society, and topics related to business life such as entrepreneurship, marketing strategies, and economic trends.
Unit 1 - Future of Work, Unit 2 - Human Resources, Unit 3 - Growth and Globalization.
90 Euros for WFR3 Advanced (13 double hours, including final exam).
